records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Group
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *North Group* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly paused evaluation for ~a week (email:a1e7a540), longer than the 8 days left. Project created day 0 but no invite and no key milestone since (email:87b278b6); kickoff held yet still undecided (calendar:9f0a183b). Starter, no tickets, little momentum.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield is right for the team. I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often helps an evaluation: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real workflow land there tends to answer the question faster than anything I can say.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week to help you set up that one workflow — otherwise I'll check back after your week is up.

Best,
Chidi
